prompt: Describe how a larger chunked workflow would detect duplicate assets appearing in different chunks.
answer: A larger workflow must retain a global seen-key set or external unique-key registry across chunks,not just check duplicates within each chunk. Validate a fixed schema/context on every chunk; detect within-chunk and cross-chunk repeats,including equal values,then abort or quarantine under an explicit policy. Check the independently expected universe and aggregate controls only after the entire input completes; withhold final valuation/report publication on later failure. For bounded memory use a transactional unique-key staging table or external sort/partition strategy with global checks,not an unbounded in-memory set disguised as streaming. Original full-file loader rejects a duplicated record appended after the fixture;that is not a chunked implementation or scalability test.
